title: Specific Relief Punjab Amendment Repeal Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Specific Relief Punjab Amendment Repeal Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIX of 1983
ORDINANCE XIX of 1983
SPECIFIC RELIEF (PUNJAB
AMENDMENT) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance to repeal the Specific Relief
(Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 19th November, 1983]
No. Legis. 3 (19);83.-The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information :-
1. Short tide and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Specific Relief (Punjab
Amendment) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Specific Relief Punjab Amendment Repeal Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Repeal of Punjab, Ordinance No. IV of 1983

ORDINANCE XIX of 1983
ORDINANCE XIX of 1983
SPECIFIC RELIEF (PUNJAB
AMENDMENT) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance to repeal the Specific Relief
(Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 19th November, 1983]
No. Legis. 3 (19);83.-The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information :-
2. Repeal of Punjab, Ordinance
No. IV of 1983.-- The Specific Relief (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1983 is
hereby repealed and shall be deemed to have been so repealed with effect from
1st March, 1983 as if it had never come into force.
